a: The armed style treats `italic: false` as "absent", though a run's italic is tri-state, so Cmd+I at a caret in an upright run under an italic node does nothing
Pasted `white-space: pre-line` / `white-space-collapse: preserve-breaks` keep every space and tab, because `\b` matches before the hyphen
A `container` change mid-edit throws away everything typed, with no commit, no `onEnd` and no `onInput`
`startEdit` with no container leaves an edit "open" that shows nothing and nothing ends
b: A character typed at the start of a run's text node takes that run's style, while the published caret style says the run to its left
Superscript/subscript toggles can never take off a node-level `script`
Pasted `white-space: pre-line` (or `white-space-collapse: preserve-breaks`) markup loses its line breaks
